name: mirage
text: BK1 part 1 done and on main: ~50 small/soft books (Fliff, Sportzino, Thrillzz, Rebet, BetUS, MyBookie, 1xBet, TonyBet, Betika, SportyBet, Star Sports and similar sweepstakes, offshore and tiny regional books) can no longer feed any fair line, and PropLine is no longer asked for them (its book list now fits one request, so fewer credits). Kept: DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, bet365, Fanatics, theScore, Hard Rock, Pinnacle, Circa, Bookmaker, BetOnline, Bovada, exchanges, and big licensed European/Australian books. The list is in research/book_reputation_2026-11-07.md; I judged it from our own book studies rather than a live web search, so tell me any book you want added or removed. Still open: the docs review for ParlayAPI/Novig/PropLine and the team/player/prop matching audit. The engine uses the new rule from its next start.
